to the effect that all nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta-function ζ(s) (s =

developments of modern mathematics in general and of prime number theory

unit_result_entry.why_material: Rewrites each discrepancy using the fractional-part Bernoulli function, expands its square, and isolates a double Mertens-weighted Bernoulli correlation to which Lemma 7 applies.

unit_dependency_entry.context_note: This is the first conceptual step in the proof of Franel's theorem.
unit_dependency_entry.representation_dependency: Normalization constants and summation indices are formula-sensitive; the expansion strategy is clear.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Bernoulli identities and congruence counting prove the three-term law
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Adapts a pointwise Bernoulli identity, sums it over congruence classes, and evaluates exceptional integral cases to turn analytic-looking correlations into gcd data.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Cyclic averaging exposes the Dedekind three-term relation
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Introduces a triple sum, observes its invariance under cyclic permutation, and averages the three presentations so Lemma 8 can replace Dedekind terms by symmetric gcd expressions.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Farey discrepancies are converted to Bernoulli correlations, then to generalized Dedekind sums, cyclically symmetrized, and finally collapsed by gcd/Möbius identities; the formula's origin is this representation chain rather than a direct discrepancy calculation.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The exact coefficients are unsafe in the extracted text and must be checked against the source page image before formal or computational use.
